author: GameTrailers
description:
Throttle Trace is available now in Steam Early Access. Check out the Throttle Trace trailer for this racing game, where speed is only the beginning and every corner is a decision. 

Built around an immediately accessible throttle-and-brake control scheme but powered by a detailed simulation underneath, Throttle Trace distills racing down to the decisions that matter: how much speed to carry into a corner, when to push the tires, when to preserve them, where to attack, when to defend, and how to react when weather, traffic, damage, or strategy suddenly change the race.
title: Throttle Trace - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Launch Trailer for Critical Shift, a sci-fi tactical strategy RPG developed by Rhinotales. Players will take point to lead elite operatives into the trenches of an Antarctic research facility. Get lethal angles on the enemy, manage resources, and uncover a sinister truth under the ice. Critical Shift is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on PC (Steam).
title: Critical Shift - Official Playtest Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Playtest Release Date Trailer for SinsKiller, an isometric action arcade shooter developed by Kimera Forge. Players will wield ancient arcane magic to take on hordes of enemies and bosses alike. Unlock new power-ups, complete quests, and face your sins. SinsKiller is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest launching on September 28.
title: SinsKiller - Official Playtest Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Moonlight Shadow, a dark fantasy action soulslike game developed by SoulsGameDev. Players will master the art of combat to dodge, parry, and dash out of harm's way in the heat of battle. Uncover long-forgotten secrets and overcome darkness in Moonlight Shadow, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Moonlight Shadows - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Tidy Up the Town, an organization-collecting game developed by Pawsmonaut Games. Players will practice their rudimentary magic-based abilities in the center of town. Clean up the mess that remains in Tidy Up the Town, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Tidy Up the Town - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action shooter developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will take on the city of Blackwood, with all of its trials and tribulations at the forefront. Organize the day-to-day operations of a DVD store by day while becoming entrenched in the criminal underworld by night. Live the dangerous double life in Blackwood, available now on PC (Steam).
title: Blackwood - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a peek at gameplay and more from Break The Night in this teaser trailer for the upcoming high-speed Hack 'N' Slash about magical girls stuck in a world of nightmares. Break The Night is inspired by late 2000s aesthetics and combo-heavy action games. Break The Night will be available on PC via Steam.
title: Break The Night - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Narrative Recap Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the upcoming installment in the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Take a look at the main narrative beats that started with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2019, leading into Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and 3, and eventually continuing with the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 that takes the story to uncharted regions. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official Narrative Recap Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Season 2 Phase 2 Launch Trailer for The Division Resurgence, a free-to-play action mobile shooter developed by Ubisoft. Players can progress to earn rewards for Season 2 Phase 2 through the Classified Ops Pass, packed with 50 tiers of rewards, weapon and Operator cosmetics, and more to take into the fight. Season 2 Phase 2 is available now for The Division Resurgence on iOS and Android.
title: The Division Resurgence - Official Season 2 Phase 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 2v2 Team Domination Gameplay Overview for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, a war strategy action game developed by KING Art. Players can get a look at intense 2v2 gameplay of Team Domination as each side fights for more and more control of the map. Get the rundown on key strategies in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4, launching on November 30 for PC (Steam).
title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official 2v2 Team Domination Gameplay Overview

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join the cast and crew of HOUR ZERO for a behind-the-scenes look at this live-action prelude to the Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve game.

In this live-action mini-series, three strangers survive the opening days of the Republic of Sotoa's invasion of the Federation of Central Usea. Josh Holloway stars as a pilot with nowhere to land, Brandon Routh as a doctor who saved his enemy, and Tamlyn Tomita as a news anchor silenced for telling the truth. 

HOUR ZERO will span four total episodes and will be available first on IGN.com and IGN's YouTube Channel.

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 2, 2026.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Live-Action HOUR ZERO Behind-the-Scenes 3 Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Id Character Guide for Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, the hit action fighting game developed by Cygames and ARC System Works. Players can get the rundown on the next DLC character being added to the roster, with Id joining the fight. Learn about Id's moveset, abilities, and techniques in combat to reign victorious. Fight as Id on September 17 in Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Official Id Character Guide

author: GameTrailers
description:
Professional Ship Simulator is out now in Early Access on PC (via Steam and Epic Games Store). Check out the Professional Ship Simulator early access launch trailer for this maritime simulation game to see features and more.

Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation game, Professional Ship Simulator. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career.
title: Professional Ship Simulator - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Update 1.5 Teaser Trailer for Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, the hit first-person action shooter developed by Expression Games. Players will take to the battlefield with more artillery to continue the fight. Wield the M14 and Type 56 SKS as infantry, or take to the skies in the Bell UH-1 Iroquois ‘Huey’ to rain down hellfire. Update 1.5 for Hell Let Loose: Vietnam is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - Official Update 1.5 Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection is available now on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. Check out the Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection launch trailer for this compilation of the sim game, which features Two Point Hospital and all the DLC. 

The Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection features the Culture Shock, A Stitch in Time DLC, and the Speedy Recovery DLC. The DLC brings 9 hospitals to manage, gameplay mechanics, and over 80 illnesses to cure. The Full Health Collection also includes Bigfoot, Pebberley Island, Close Encounters & Off the Grid expansions, plus a booster of free items, including the Retro Items Pack, Fancy Dress Pack, and more.
title: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, the hit action-adventure LEGO game developed by TT Games. Players can take the legend of Batman on the go with the release on Nintendo Switch 2. Explore all eras and media of the Caped Crusader, from comics to film, with LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, available now for Nintendo Switch 2 alongside PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the world you'll explore and the monsters you'll face in Monster Hunter Outlanders in this new trailer for the upcoming open-world action RPG. In Monster Hunter Outlanders, race across vast fields and set out on journeys into the unknown with your allies.

Monster Hunter Outlanders will be available on the App Store and Google Play, with pre-registration available now.
title: Monster Hunter Outlanders - Official Trailer | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch this extended cut of the first trailer for Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, an upcoming expansion for the action RPG. Stay tuned to the end of the trailer for a peek at a fiery foe. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. 

In Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, the massive Elder Dragon's attack heralds change in the Forbidden Lands, for both land and sky. Bracing for danger, the Expedition steels themselves as familiar and undiscovered Elder Dragons emerge - and a disturbing new threat prowls the land. 

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official 1st Trailer (Extended Cut) | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Terranigma gets a new trailer and a release date. Get a fresh look at gameplay and features of Terranigma in this latest trailer for the upcoming action RPG, as this classic from 1995 returns and will be available to play on modern consoles. Terranigma will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and GOG) on January 14, 2027.

The Earth is a hollow sphere with two sides: an external Lightside and an internal Darkside. In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world.
title: Terranigma - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Bayonetta Teaser Trailer for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds, the hit SEGA-themed character action racing game developed by Sonic Team and SEGA. Players can check out the first character in Year Two as Bayonetta makes her debut on the track. Catch Bayonetta in action soon in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds, available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Official Bayonetta Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Even special agents deserve to take a vacation. Check out the latest Street Fighter 6 trailer to see the C. Viper Outfit 4. Street Fighter 6 Year 4 Passes are available now. Street Fighter 6 is out now on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Street Fighter 6 - Official C. Viper Outfit 4 Showcase Trailer | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Main Trailer for Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, an upcoming expansion to the hit open-world action RPG developed by Capcom. Players will embark on a new adventure with tales to experience and action-packed encounters to overcome. Explore a new area in the Snowy North to take on 12 Dungeon Challenges and unlock new weapons and skills along the way. title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Official Main Trailer | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Back to Chaos' Gameplay Trailer for Kemuri, an upcoming action co-op game developed by Unseen. Players will embody Yokai Hunters to explore the city of Kemuri and all the tribulations that come with being so close to the afterlife. Harness paranormal abilities, parkour through the city at blazing speeds, and take out anomalies that ordinary people cannot see. Kemuri is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC.
title: Kemuri - Official 'Back to Chaos' Gameplay Trailer (Japanese Audio)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Last Wail of the Sea King announcement trailer for this upcoming surreal adventure inspired by classic party-based RPGs. Last Wail of the Sea King throws players into the belly of a gigantic sea beast, where an entire strange world has grown inside its living body. Meet the creatures that call it home, recruit unlikely allies, and fight your way through turn-based battles

Last Wail of the Sea King will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Last Wail of the Sea King - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Features Trailer for the PlayStation PULSE Edge Wireless Headset, a new and improved version of the PULSE Edge headset lineup developed by Sony. Players on PS5 can enjoy precise audio, active noise-cancelling, vivid voice chat via a detachable boom mic, and the comfort of taking the headset on the go courtesy of the included carrying case. Get the edge in-game on PlayStation 5 with the PlayStation PULSE Edge Wireless Headset, launching in early 2027.
title: PlayStation PULSE Edge Wireless Headset - Official Features Trailer

description: Check out the Features Trailer for the PlayStation PULSE Wireless Headset, a high-quality headset for PlayStation 5 developed by Sony. The PlayStation 5 PULSE Wireless Headset is coming soon in Holiday 2026.
title: PlayStation PULSE Wireless Headset - Official Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for Wo-Long 2: Wings of Ember, the sequel to Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja's popular Chinese Mythology action soulslike! 

Set during the Three Kingdoms era, during which the land is divided into three factions, with warriors fighting for their respective beliefs. Among the conflict, a warrior with the power of the phoenix arrives, crossing the battlefields to battle both man and mythical demons! 

Wo Long 2 Wings of Ember Alpha Demo is out now until September 30th, beat it to unlock the Fledgling Phoenix Helmet when Wo Long 2 Wings of Ember  releases March  4th, 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Xbox on PC), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance, a story-driven action drone simulation game developed by Anraga Studios and The Farm 51. Players will pilot a life-saving drone to head into the fray of dangerous situations, from fires to natural disasters. Assess damage, monitor weather conditions, and ensure the safety of the public, one flight at a time. Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance - Official Announcement Trailer
